architecture: geometric covariance pool with regime gate and learned spectral cleaning
training: equal normalized forecast-distance and squared portfolio-return losses
selection: minimize worse of validation Frobenius ratio and long-only mean-square-return ratio against HAR-DRD
success_rule: both primary paired 95% intervals must be strictly below zero against HAR-DRD; report other comparisons separately
qualification: 2025-2026 outcomes were already inspected for the previous extension; this is a reused retrospective benchmark, not a fresh confirmation sample
iteration_rule: report the fixed candidate and its static control without retuning after viewing benchmark outcomes
gate_refit_note: quarterly gate refits; daily observed inputs; original HAR experts retain monthly refits
